name: Courchevel

seo.title: Courchevel ski resort guide
seo.description: Six villages from 1,100 to 1,850 metres on the pass to Les 3 Vallées - 600 km of slopes and 337 runs, open 4 December to 18 April.
seo.twitterDescription: Six villages on the 600 km Les 3 Vallées pass.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Courchevel in Savoie.

h1: Courchevel ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Courchevel is not one village but six, stacked up the mountainside from Saint Bon at 1,100 metres to Courchevel itself at 1,850. All of them open onto Les 3 Vallées, which the operator calls the largest ski area in the world: 600 kilometres of slopes across 337 runs and seven resorts, with 85 per cent of it above 1,800 metres. The season runs 4 December to 18 April.
stayOverview: The six villages each have their own character and their own price: Le Praz and La Tania are quiet and wooded, Village and Moriond are family ground, and Courchevel 1850 is the one the resort was built around.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The higher the village, the shorter the walk to a lift and the steeper the rate.
rentalCars: Courchevel is reached up the Tarentaise valley from Moûtiers, about two hours from Geneva.
